profile_description: Publish a year-to-date snapshot across all projects. With backup on, it includes your other devices and updates automatically. Your profile stays available when Zuse is closed.
profile_handle_hint: 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Your handle is permanent and stays reserved when unpublished.
profile_privacy: Only your chosen identity and aggregate counts are published: tokens by day, month, model, type, and tool; project and session counts; and session lengths. Cost and time of day are published only if you turn them on. Chats, project names, paths, and session IDs stay private. Counts are self-reported; snapshots update only when you publish.
profile_load_error: Could not load your profile or usage. Sign in to Zuse and retry.
profile_handle_error: That handle is unavailable. Choose another handle.
profile_save_error: Could not save your profile. Check your connection and retry.
profile_copy_error: Could not copy the link. You can select and copy it manually.
profile_unpublished: Your profile is unpublished. Its public link is no longer available.
profile_show_cost_hint: About {{amount}} at API prices. Off by default.
profile_cost_unavailable: No pricing is available for your models yet.
profile_show_hours_hint: Reveals when you usually work, in your local time. Off by default.
backup_description: Coding tools delete old logs. Zuse keeps an hourly history on this device; backing it up to your Zuse account keeps it across reinstalls and devices, adds your personal cloud workspaces, and keeps a published profile current.
backup_switch: Back up to my Zuse account
backup_interval: Syncs every 3 days while Zuse is open.
backup_delete: Delete the account copy when turning off
backup_error: The last backup failed. Zuse will try again automatically.
backup_load_error: Could not update backup. Sign in to Zuse and retry.
backup_privacy: Only hourly token and cost totals are uploaded. Session and project identifiers are replaced with private keys; chats, names, and paths never leave this device.
